title: RAGAM-AI: A Hybrid Reinforcement Learning based Agentic approach powered by Generative AI for Edge Resource Management
title_zh: RAGAM-AI：一种由生成式 AI 驱动的、基于混合强化学习的边缘资源管理智能体方法

paragraphs.en: Resource management for distributed edge networks hosting different services has been handled efficiently using Reinforcement learning (RL). Reward generalization in complex workflows is still an open issue within the RL realm. Therefore, this work proposes RAGAM-AI, a hybrid framework that combines the capabilities of RL algorithms and Generative-AI (Gen-AI) for powering an Agentic AI workflow that optimizes resource allocation at the Multi-access Edge Computing (MEC) units. This framework further resolves the reward generalization issue by utilizing Large Language Model (LLM) for feedback. A Multi-Agent Soft-Actor Critic (MASAC) using Math Σ \Sigma tral as a reward oracle is implemented for managing resource allocations at the MEC. RAGAM-AI interprets system state information and evaluates multi-objective trade-offs guiding the resource orchestration loop over distributed edge server agents. The complexity of the framework is further brought down by incorporating surrogate reward model. The overall performance is evaluated against the single agent SAC, REINFORCE and random policies for benchmarking. On using RAGAM-AI, lower allocation deviations for CPU, memory and bandwidth resources are reported while minimizing the latency and data rate costs. A scalable AI as a feedback (AIAF) solution optimizing network resources with significant performance improvement is thus presented.
paragraphs.zh: 强化学习（RL）已被高效地用于托管不同服务的分布式边缘网络的资源管理。 在强化学习领域，复杂工作流中的奖励泛化仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。 因此，本工作提出 RAGAM-AI，这是一个混合框架，结合了强化学习算法和生成式 AI（Gen-AI）的能力，以驱动一个智能体 AI 工作流，优化多接入边缘计算（MEC）单元处的资源分配。 该框架进一步利用大语言模型（LLM）进行反馈，解决了奖励泛化问题。 实现了使用 Math Σ \Sigma tral 作为奖励预言机的多智能体软演员-评论家（MASAC），用于管理 MEC 处的资源分配。 RAGAM-AI 解释系统状态信息并评估多目标权衡，从而指导分布式边缘服务器智能体上的资源编排循环。 通过引入代理奖励模型，进一步降低了该框架的复杂度。 整体性能通过与单智能体 SAC、REINFORCE 和随机策略进行对比评估作为基准测试。 使用 RAGAM-AI 后，在最小化时延和数据速率成本的同时，CPU、内存和带宽资源的分配偏差更低。 由此提出了一种可扩展的 AI 即反馈（AIAF）解决方案，在显著提升性能的同时优化网络资源。

paragraphs.en: THE limitations presented by a centralized cloud architecture discouraged localized processing of tasks increasing latency and congestion within networks. In such a scenario, a MEC at the edge of the network emerged as a solution for bringing computation and devices closer enabling task offloading in resource-constrained conditions [ 1 ] . MEC is further in control of network resources such as compute power, bandwidth and memory. However, efficient resource management within MEC yet remains as a critical and challenging problem. The long-established systems fail to consider non-stationary network traffic distributions and the coupling effect between different resources [ 2 ] . Heterogeneous nodes now cater to diverse use-cases that require low-latencies and faster compute capacities. Many of these issues are resolved at the edge network with the help of MEC servers. Long transmission time, energy expenditures and data breaches are alleviated by partially or fully offloaded tasks to the edge [ 3 ] . On the other hand, edge caching relieves delays caused from the backhaul pressure significantly by fetching frequently accessed data [ 4 ] . Fault tolerance and system resiliency can be improved by having task distribution and decision-making closer to the network rather than a centralized cloud [ 5 ] . There is an enhanced context-awareness as information with regards to local radio link signals and network traffic load bursts become more available [ 6 ] . There are numerous use-cases that benefit from putting edge computing into operation. In Vehicle-to-everything (V2X), smart transportation systems’ edge computing has enabled low latency and high reliability safety services [ 7 ] . Edge networks can support real-time fault-detection and load balancing in smart grids alleviating network outage issues [ 8 ] . For running inferences, analytics and predictive maintenance, Industrial IoT (IIoT) often rely on edge powered solutions [ 9 ] . Edge caching is often used for Extended Reality (XR) technologies for providing rendering support [ 10 ] . Digital twins require localized optimization for data-ingestion and for processing sensor outputs relying on edge support [ 11 ] . However, a wide range of open challenges continues to limit practical deployment of these use-cases. Various network aspects such as compute, storage, communication and energy are optimized in isolation due to independently functioning Radio Access Network (RAN) and MEC orchestrators [ 16 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 集中式云架构所带来的局限性阻碍了任务的本地化处理，导致网络内延迟增加和拥塞加剧。 在这种情况下，位于网络边缘的移动边缘计算（MEC）应运而生，作为将计算和设备拉得更近的解决方案，从而在资源受限的条件下实现任务卸载 [1]。 MEC 还进一步控制着计算能力、带宽和内存等网络资源。 然而，MEC 内部的高效资源管理仍然是一个关键且具有挑战性的问题。 传统的既有系统未能考虑非平稳的网络流量分布以及不同资源之间的耦合效应 [2]。 如今异构节点服务于多种多样的用例，这些用例需要低延迟和更快的计算能力。 借助 MEC 服务器，许多此类问题都在边缘网络中得到解决。 通过将任务部分或全部卸载到边缘，可以缓解传输时间长、能耗高和数据泄露等问题 [3]。 另一方面，边缘缓存通过获取频繁访问的数据，显著缓解了回传链路压力造成的延迟 [4]。 通过使任务分配和决策更靠近网络而非集中式云，可以提高容错能力和系统弹性 [5]。 由于与本地无线链路信号和网络流量负载突发相关的信息变得更容易获取，情境感知能力得到了增强 [6]。 众多用例都能从部署边缘计算中受益。 在车联网（V2X）中，智能交通系统的边缘计算已能够提供低延迟、高可靠性的安全服务 [7]。 边缘网络可以支持智能电网中的实时故障检测和负载均衡，缓解网络中断问题 [8]。 在运行推理、分析和预测性维护方面，工业物联网（IIoT）通常依赖边缘驱动的解决方案 [9]。 边缘缓存常用于扩展现实（XR）技术，以提供渲染支持 [10]。 数字孪生需要在边缘支持下进行本地化优化，以实现数据摄取和处理传感器输出 [11]。 然而，一系列广泛的开放性挑战仍在限制这些用例的实际部署。 由于无线接入网（RAN）编排器和 MEC 编排器各自独立运行，计算、存储、通信和能耗等各种网络方面被孤立地进行优化 [16]。

paragraphs.en: Network handover and service migration are not yet completely service-aware, causing disruption in providing quality services to the end user [ 13 ] . The privacy and security concerns at the edge in distributed settings are also issues of concern in order to make the systems more fault resilient [ 14 ] . Limitations on the standards and the available 5G architectures make the cross-domain interactions complex leading to unsatisfied Service Level Agreements (SLA) [ 15 ] . RL has emerged as a promising solution to bridge some of the gaps mentioned above. Resource allocation is now possible subject to dynamic network conditions using RL’s learning abilities even under fluctuating workloads [ 16 ] . Multi-objective optimization involving both the communication and compute requirements can be achieved using RL [ 17 ] . Decentralized distributed multi-agent RL system enables localized learning at each node contributing to global objectives in dense edge deployments [ 18 ] . RL-based approaches have also showcased reduction in overall latencies and energy expenditures with better resource utilization [ 19 ] . The advantages of using RL algorithms at the edge got further enhanced with the availability of Generative modeling. RL algorithms often are constrained by partial observability, limited training data and lack of explainability. Generative models can assist RL algorithms by synthesizing unforeseen scenarios and help in generalization [ 20 ] . RL algorithms involve interactive learning with the environment often making it sample inefficient and expensive [ 21 ] . Gen-AI aided intervention can alleviate this problem by optimizing the search spaces and reducing some of the interactions. In recent times, there’s an increasing interest in autonomous frameworks that can manage and execute sophisticated decisions entirely on its own. These systems give rise to concepts like Agentic-AI systems and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) which breakdown complex tasks into independent sub-tasks at both the training and evaluation level [ 22 ] . Further, the performance enhancement is achieved using valuable feedback through methods like Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) and Reinforcement Learning from AI Feedback (RLAIF) [ 23 , 24 ] . In RLHF, direct human assessment is included as a feedback creating scalability and expense issues. On the other hand, RLAIF involves AI assistants for supervising the algorithm behaviour.
paragraphs.zh: 网络切换与服务迁移尚未完全实现服务感知，导致难以持续为终端用户提供高质量服务 [ 13 ] 。 分布式环境下边缘侧的隐私与安全问题，也是提升系统容错韧性时需要关注的问题 [ 14 ] 。 标准的局限性以及现有 5G 架构的不足使跨域交互变得复杂，导致服务水平协议（SLA）无法得到满足 [ 15 ] 。 强化学习（RL）已成为弥合上述部分缺口的一种有前景的解决方案。 借助强化学习的学习能力，如今即使在工作负载波动的情况下，也能依据动态网络条件进行资源分配 [ 16 ] 。 利用强化学习可以同时兼顾通信与计算需求，实现多目标优化 [ 17 ] 。 去中心化的分布式多智能体强化学习系统能够在每个节点进行本地化学习，从而在密集的边缘部署中助力实现全局目标 [ 18 ] 。 基于强化学习的方法还展现出更优的资源利用率，同时降低了整体时延与能耗 [ 19 ] 。 生成式建模的出现进一步增强了在边缘使用强化学习算法的优势。 强化学习算法常常受限于部分可观测性、训练数据有限以及缺乏可解释性。 生成式模型可以通过合成未预见场景来辅助强化学习算法，并帮助提升泛化能力 [ 20 ] 。 强化学习算法需要与环境进行交互式学习，这往往导致样本效率低下且成本高昂 [ 21 ] 。 生成式人工智能辅助的干预可以通过优化搜索空间并减少部分交互来缓解这一问题。 近来，人们对能够完全自主管理和执行复杂决策的自主框架的兴趣日益浓厚。 这些系统催生了智能体人工智能系统和专家混合等概念，它们在训练与评估层面都将复杂任务分解为独立的子任务 [ 22 ] 。 此外，还可以通过人类反馈强化学习（RLHF）和人工智能反馈强化学习（RLAIF）等方法，利用有价值的反馈来提升性能 [ 23 , 24 ] 。 在 RLHF 中，直接由人类进行评估作为反馈，这带来了可扩展性和成本方面的问题。 另一方面，RLAIF 则引入人工智能助手来监督算法的行为。

paragraphs.en: Keeping in mind all the discussion above, it can be established that resource management at the network edge is still a fundamental challenge as the networks becomes more heterogeneous with diverse performance constraints. RL algorithms provide a promising relief for adaptive decision-making while still coping with reward bias and explainability challenges. The studies [ 25 , 26 ] confirm that imperfect or rigid reward formulations can indeed affect the learning capabilities of the RL policies. These issues are especially relevant in edge resource orchestration, where static reward shaping may inadequately capture dynamic trade-offs among latency, utilization, fairness, and demand variability. Recent advances in Gen-AI when combined with existing RL solutions can provide the required performance enhancement improving the sample efficiency and the semantic reasoning for generalization. Therefore, in this work, a hybrid framework utilizing the learning capabilities of a distributed Multi-Agent Deep RL (MADRL) at the MEC is integrated with the feedback from GenAI-based LLM model extending the preliminary results in [ 27 ] . The framework incorporates multiple interacting RL agents operating across edge nodes driven by feedback from the LLM. The policy updates are coordinated through shared environmental objectives and reward signals. The framework therefore showcases core agentic properties of autonomy, feedback inclusion, task distribution and adaptive behavior. The framework thus achieved is interpreted as an agentic-AI system successful in eliminating the reward bias and in improving the overall algorithm performance measured in terms of efficient allocations, latency and data rate. paragraphs.en: Attempts have been made using traditional optimization techniques to manage and orchestrate the edge network resources in various works. The authors of [ 28 ] , propose a multi-objective evolutionary optimization framework to resolve the task offloading and resource allocation issues at the MEC servers. The developed decomposition-based evolutionary algorithm thus developed minimizes average task completion time and energy consumption of mobile devices. A MEC architecture catering to Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) and Device-to-Device (D2D) communication for efficient resource utilization is proposed in [ 29 ] . A joint optimization problem integrating trajectory design, resource allocation, and task offloading decisions is formulated minimizing computation latency. In [ 30 ] , user Quality of Experience (QoE) in federated MEC systems is jointly optimized using service caching, computational resource allocation, and task offloading. A novel two-stage algorithmic framework based on approximation and decomposition techniques framed as a Mixed-Integer Non Linear Programming (MINLP) with multi-layer constraints. A resource-efficient joint service caching and workload scheduling framework for ultra-dense edge networks is proposed in [ 31 ] . The developed CoShare algorithm reduces the workload on the cloud by utilizing Lyapunov technique for optimization. The research work in [ 32 ] uses genetic algorithm for joint optimization of offloading ratios, wireless bandwidth allocation, and computational resource distribution. Simulation results demonstrates reduction in task completion time while maintaining performance.
paragraphs.zh: 已有多项工作尝试使用传统优化技术来管理和编排边缘网络资源。 文献[28]的作者提出了一种多目标进化优化框架，以解决MEC服务器上的任务卸载和资源分配问题。 由此开发的基于分解的进化算法可最小化移动设备的平均任务完成时间和能耗。 文献[29]提出了一种面向无人机（UAV）和设备到设备（D2D）通信的MEC架构，以实现高效的资源利用。 该工作构建了一个联合优化问题，将轨迹设计、资源分配和任务卸载决策整合在一起，以最小化计算时延。 文献[30]通过服务缓存、计算资源分配和任务卸载，对联邦MEC系统中的用户体验质量（QoE）进行联合优化。 该工作提出了一种基于近似和分解技术的新型两阶段算法框架，其被构建为具有多层约束的混合整数非线性规划（MINLP）问题。 文献[31]提出了一种面向超密集边缘网络的资源高效型联合服务缓存与工作负载调度框架。 所开发的CoShare算法利用李雅普诺夫（Lyapunov）技术进行优化，从而减少云端的负载。 文献[32]采用遗传算法对卸载比例、无线带宽分配和计算资源分配进行联合优化。 仿真结果表明，该方法在保持性能的同时降低了任务完成时间。

paragraphs.en: Over time, many of the open challenges were mitigated by making use of RL advancements. A two-level slicing model is introduced in [ 16 ] for dynamic network-slicing and resource allocation. The network slicing is resolved with a QMIX-based RL algorithm while the resource allocation is resolved using a Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) based algorithm. In [ 33 ] , a cloud-native architecture explores resource allocation efficiency and network resource utilization. The architecture is validated by testing it on a testbed to demonstrate the improvements. The authors of [ 34 ] use hierarchical RL to tackle joint caching and resource allocation issues in MEC systems. In recent times digital twins have gained popularity leading to high compute requirements at the edge. In [ 35 ] , a federated deep RL scheme is designed to optimize task offloading, configurations of passive reflecting links, and computing resources from a two-layer digital twin edge network. A Knowledge-Defined Edge Computing Networks (KDECN) architecture along with a RL-based Long-term Computation Offloading and computation Resource Allocation (L-CORA) algorithm is presented in [ 36 ] . This approach intends to manage large-scale networks ensuring long-term quality of computing service for user devices. In the context of Vehicular Edge Computing (VEC), Multi-Agent Diffusion-based Deep RL (MAD2RL) is proposed in [ 37 ] to jointly optimize Deep Neural Net (DNN) partitioning, task offloading, and resource allocation. In addition to that, a Lyapunov optimization technique is initially used to decouple the long-term problem into a per-slot deterministic problem. A novel solution combining blockchain-mining and edge system improving the overall system utility is presented in [ 38 ] . The multi-objective formulation thus developed jointly optimizes offloading decision, channel selection, transmit power allocation, and computational resource allocation. In [ 39 ] , low-latency video communication ensuring video quality in Mobile Augmented Reality (MAR) applications is explored. A Gated Recurrent Unit-Augmented Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (GTD3) is used to resolve the challenges from the need for dynamic computational resources and limited availability of network bandwidth. The authors of [ 40 ] propose a novel MADRL algorithm in the MEC infrastructure within Space-Air-Ground Integrated Networks (SAGINs).

sents.en: In recent times digital twins have gained popularity leading to high compute requirements at the edge.
sents.zh: 近年来，数字孪生日益流行，导致边缘侧的计算需求大幅增加。

sents.en: In [ 35 ] , a federated deep RL scheme is designed to optimize task offloading, configurations of passive reflecting links, and computing resources from a two-layer digital twin edge network.
sents.zh: 文献[35]设计了一种联邦深度强化学习方案，用于从双层数字孪生边缘网络中优化任务卸载、无源反射链路的配置以及计算资源。

sents.en: A Knowledge-Defined Edge Computing Networks (KDECN) architecture along with a RL-based Long-term Computation Offloading and computation Resource Allocation (L-CORA) algorithm is presented in [ 36 ] .
sents.zh: 文献[36]提出了一种知识定义边缘计算网络（KDECN）架构，以及一种基于强化学习的长期计算卸载与计算资源分配（L-CORA）算法。

sents.en: This approach intends to manage large-scale networks ensuring long-term quality of computing service for user devices.
sents.zh: 该方法旨在管理大规模网络，确保用户设备的长期计算服务质量。

sents.en: In the context of Vehicular Edge Computing (VEC), Multi-Agent Diffusion-based Deep RL (MAD2RL) is proposed in [ 37 ] to jointly optimize Deep Neural Net (DNN) partitioning, task offloading, and resource allocation.
sents.zh: 在车辆边缘计算（VEC）的背景下，文献[37]提出了多智能体扩散式深度强化学习（MAD2RL），以联合优化深度神经网络（DNN）分割、任务卸载和资源分配。

sents.en: In addition to that, a Lyapunov optimization technique is initially used to decouple the long-term problem into a per-slot deterministic problem.
sents.zh: 除此之外，还首先使用李雅普诺夫优化技术将长期问题解耦为每时隙的确定性问题。

sents.en: A novel solution combining blockchain-mining and edge system improving the overall system utility is presented in [ 38 ] .
sents.zh: 文献[38]提出了一种结合区块链挖矿与边缘系统的新型解决方案，提升了整体系统效用。

sents.en: The multi-objective formulation thus developed jointly optimizes offloading decision, channel selection, transmit power allocation, and computational resource allocation.
sents.zh: 由此构建的多目标公式化联合优化卸载决策、信道选择、发射功率分配和计算资源分配。

sents.en: In [ 39 ] , low-latency video communication ensuring video quality in Mobile Augmented Reality (MAR) applications is explored.
sents.zh: 文献[39]探索了移动增强现实（MAR）应用中确保视频质量的低时延视频通信。

sents.en: A Gated Recurrent Unit-Augmented Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (GTD3) is used to resolve the challenges from the need for dynamic computational resources and limited availability of network bandwidth.
sents.zh: 采用门控循环单元增强的孪生延迟深度确定性策略梯度（GTD3）来解决动态计算资源需求和网络带宽有限所带来的挑战。

sents.en: The authors of [ 40 ] propose a novel MADRL algorithm in the MEC infrastructure within Space-Air-Ground Integrated Networks (SAGINs).
sents.zh: 文献[40]的作者在空天地一体化网络（SAGIN）的移动边缘计算基础设施中提出了一种新颖的多智能体深度强化学习（MADRL）算法。

paragraphs.en: The ground user tasks are modelled as Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs) while reducing energy consumption and latency in MEC.
paragraphs.zh: 地面用户任务被建模为有向无环图（DAG），同时在移动边缘计算（MEC）中降低能耗与时延。

paragraphs.en: Introduction of GenAI applications in RL-based systems has brought tremendous shift in how intelligent systems learn, adapt, and make decisions. For instance, in [ 41 ] , an innovative framework called EdgeNetLLM is developed for efficiently adapting LLM models for the tasks of adaptive bitrate streaming (ABR) and cluster job scheduling (CJS) in mobile networks. Additionally, it can also adapt to specific tasks and inputs minimizing the overall costs and latency. In [ 42 ] , a Two-Timescale Deep RL (T2DRL) algorithm is decomposed as a caching subproblem on a long-timescale and a resource allocation subproblem on a short-timescale. The algorithm is designed for resource provisioning in edge-enabled AIGC service for reducing latency. Similarly, the authors of [ 43 ] propose a lightweight LLM to augment RL for independent task scheduling minimizing makespan, operational costs, and energy consumption. To address the issue of GenAI models being resource-intense, [ 44 ] present a AI-Generated Optimal Decision (AGOD) algorithm for optimally select service providers. The AGOD algorithm utilizes Deep Diffusion Soft Actor-Critic (D2SAC) for increasing the efficiency of the selection made.
paragraphs.zh: 在基于强化学习的系统中引入生成式人工智能（GenAI）应用，为智能系统的学习、适应和决策方式带来了巨大变革。 例如，文献[41]提出了一个名为EdgeNetLLM的创新框架，用于高效地适配大语言模型（LLM），以完成移动网络中的自适应比特率流媒体（ABR）和集群作业调度（CJS）任务。 此外，它还能针对特定任务和输入进行适配，从而将总体成本和时延降至最低。 文献[42]将双时间尺度深度强化学习（T2DRL）算法分解为长时间尺度上的缓存子问题和短时间尺度上的资源分配子问题。 该算法面向边缘赋能的AIGC服务中的资源供给而设计，旨在降低时延。 类似地，文献[43]的作者提出了一种轻量级LLM来增强强化学习，以实现独立任务调度，从而最小化最大完成时间、运营成本和能耗。 为解决GenAI模型资源消耗高的问题，文献[44]提出了一种人工智能生成最优决策（AGOD）算法，用于最优地选择服务提供商。 AGOD算法利用深度扩散软演员-评论家（D2SAC）方法来提高所选决策的效率。

paragraphs.en: This work improves the state-of-the-art literature by emphasizing on the need for performance enhancement of existing RL algorithms by taking advantage of the advancements and availability of pre-trained LLMs. RAGAM-AI is a model-free multi-agent approach that can function under dynamic network connections. The RL policy within RAGAM-AI can be conveniently scaled to multiple servers tackling training instabilities and growing state space. Further, the centralized training and decentralized execution within the algorithm enables distributed learning. RL algorithms are often entirely driven by the reward signals, thus a poorly designed signal either introduces learning bias or amplifies the ground truth. Therefore, RAGAM-AI uses a reward oracle that combines a traditional mathematically backed reward function alongside reward signals received from mindful prompting to the Math Σ \Sigma tral model to minimize the reward generalization issue. Further, a small Deep Neural Network (DNN) is trained to mimic the reward function for lightweight architecture. The crucial contributions are listed below:
paragraphs.zh: 本工作通过强调利用预训练大语言模型（LLM）的进展与可用性来提升现有强化学习（RL）算法的性能，从而改进了当前最先进的文献。 RAGAM-AI 是一种无模型的多智能体方法，能够在动态网络连接下运行。 RAGAM-AI 中的强化学习策略可以方便地扩展到多台服务器上，以应对训练不稳定和状态空间不断增长的问题。 此外，该算法中的集中式训练与分散式执行实现了分布式学习。 强化学习算法通常完全由奖励信号驱动，因此设计不良的奖励信号要么引入学习偏差，要么放大数据的真实分布。 因此，RAGAM-AI 使用了一个奖励预言机，它将传统的基于数学的奖励函数与通过对 Math Σ \Sigma tral 模型进行审慎提示（prompting）所获得的奖励信号相结合，以最小化奖励泛化问题。 此外，还训练了一个小型深度神经网络（DNN）来模仿奖励函数，从而实现轻量化架构。 主要贡献列举如下：

paragraphs.en: Decentralized training mechanism by making use of MASAC algorithm with off-policy learning enabling scalability and sample efficiency.

paragraphs.en: Improved decision-making via hybrid Agentic AI formulation using the capabilities of interactive strategy updates through RL policies and context-based reasoning feedbacks from LLMs.
paragraphs.zh: 通过混合式智能体AI（Agentic AI）框架改进决策制定，利用强化学习（RL）策略进行交互式策略更新的能力，以及大语言模型（LLM）基于上下文的推理反馈。

paragraphs.en: For training purposes, the resource request available from Microsoft Azure Packing traces is used [ 48 ] . The publicly available dataset captures workloads from virtual machines, containers and tasks containing essential information about CPU, memory and bandwidth. These are large-scale data collected under varying realistic operational conditions. The traces were first cleaned by removing incomplete records and entries with missing or invalid resource usage values. A consistent sorting was applied to make sense of the workload ids and timestamps. The necessary resources such as CPU, memory and Bandwidth utilization value was retrieved. Hence, for this work the packing traces after extensive pre-processing were used as the resource requests.

paragraphs.en: As explained previously, the reward function utilizes the Math Σ \Sigma tral model for generating rewards using CoT prompting. These design choices are made strategically keeping in mind the requirements of the problem formulated in section III. Math Σ \Sigma tral is a specialized model for mathematical reasoning. It is fine-tuned specifically on mathematical data to generate reliable mathematical outputs with detailed explanatory solutions [ 49 ] . However, for this model to successfully generate the desired outputs, the prompts passed on to the model have to be immaculate. Therefore, given the sequential decision-making process of the problem in hand, a CoT based prompt is designed as in Fig. 2 . A step-by-step approach is more structured and thus avoids reasoning errors by validating each constraint in comparison to any other prompting styles. Additionally, the prompt is not user-driven but rather a fixed, system-controlled component of the RAGAM-AI pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 如前所述，奖励函数利用 Math Σ \Sigma tral 模型，通过 CoT 提示来生成奖励。 这些设计选择是经过深思熟虑的，充分考虑了第 III 节中所阐述问题的需求。 Math Σ \Sigma tral 是一个专门用于数学推理的模型。 它专门在数学数据上进行微调，以生成包含详细解释性解答的可靠数学输出 [ 49 ] 。 然而，要使该模型成功生成期望的输出，传递给模型的提示必须做到无懈可击。 因此，针对手头问题的顺序决策过程，设计了一种基于 CoT 的提示，如图 2 所示。 与其他任何提示风格相比，循序渐进的方式更具结构性，从而通过逐一验证每个约束条件来避免推理错误。 此外，该提示并非由用户驱动，而是 RAGAM-AI 流水线中一个固定的、由系统控制的组件。

paragraphs.en: In this work, the multi-agent RAGAM-AI based on RL-LLM framework with a systematic reward mechanism contributes significantly to system scalability and adaptability. The decentralized learning component within the RL algorithm enables each individual agent to learn policies that optimize local decision-making while adhering overall system objectives designed within the reward function. It is to be noted that the reward is not directly optimizing the resource deviations or KPI costs, rather it allows the framework to learn the network demand patterns while keeping the constraints in check. With the assistance from LLM, agents are able to interpret contextual information and introduce feedback using its pre-trained knowledge. The hybrid approach within the reward function further helps in the development of a surrogate reward model that acts a substitute replacing the otherwise undetermined task. Although the proposed RAGAM-AI method exhibits a larger spread in Fig. 5 and Fig. 6 , it can be inferred as a consequence of enhanced exploration and variability in the learned policy during training. Despite this variability, the RAGAM-AI method consistently achieves lower median cost, indicating superior performance compared to baseline approaches. The agentic system thus built iteratively adjusts its actions dynamically to meet the heterogeneous resource demands to maximize the performance. Overall, the system complexity is addressed with respect to two components: the MADRL setup and the LLM-based reward mechanism. Neither of the components require continuous inferencing on resource-constrained devices. Further, the surrogate reward model alleviates the complexity issues by enabling lightweight decision-making. Therefore, the proposed RAGAM-AI framework is more suitable for edge controllers or orchestration nodes in terms of complexity.

paragraphs.en: To summarize, in this work a hybrid Agentic-AI framework RAGAM-AI is implemented by combining the abilities of RL and Gen-AI. The multi-agent system was developed using the MASAC policy while receiving feedbacks from the Math Σ \Sigma stral inside its reward function. Network resources such as CPU, memory and bandwidth are managed at the network edge using RAGAM-AI. The main objective was to strengthen the performance of the MADRL system by augmenting it with context-aware reasoning. Hence, RAGAM-AI demonstrates effectiveness of RLAIF concept by obtaining smaller resource deviations and performance costs in comparison to the baselines. For future work, a workflow encompassing different agents conveying intents from different components such as Open-Radio Access Network (O-RAN) and cloud can be integrated. Further, this work serves as simulation for the proof-of-concept idea proposed and thus can be tested by deploying in cloud-native environments as well later. Broader metrics and processes such as caching may also be considered. Including system-level analysis in terms of runtime overhead measurements, convergence analysis, and sensitivity studies can also provide important additional insights for reducing the system complexity.
paragraphs.zh: 总而言之，本工作通过结合强化学习（RL）与生成式人工智能（Gen-AI）的能力，实现了一个混合式智能体AI框架 RAGAM-AI。 该多智能体系统采用 MASAC 策略开发，并在其奖励函数中接收来自 Math Σ \Sigma stral 的反馈。 CPU、内存和带宽等网络资源通过 RAGAM-AI 在网络边缘进行管理。 其主要目标是通过引入上下文感知推理来增强 MADRL 系统的性能。 因此，与基线方法相比，RAGAM-AI 通过获得更小的资源偏差和性能开销，展示了 RLAIF 概念的有效性。 在未来的工作中，可以集成一个涵盖多个智能体的工作流，用以传递来自开放无线接入网（O-RAN）和云等不同组件的意图。 此外，本工作是对所提出的概念验证想法的仿真，因此后续也可以通过部署到云原生环境中进行测试。 还可以考虑更广泛的指标与流程，例如缓存。 引入系统级分析，例如运行时开销测量、收敛性分析和敏感性研究，也可以为降低系统复杂度提供重要的补充见解。
